Favicons use the P cropped from the wordmark (never upscaled). og-image: #f7f3ef background, dark wordmark 560px wide centred in the left 800px, arms-crossed portrait (left hero panel) cropped to the right third.

conventions.jpg: one fallback per image, named in jpg (quality 82)
conventions.bannerText: kind banner-text has no outputs (baked-in text); listed for reference only
conventions.split: for composites: axis x = side by side, y = stacked; at = seam position as a fraction of width or height; clean = straight seam usable for a before/after slider
